[ REPUBLIC Act No. 10957]

AN ACT CREATING A BARANGAY TO BE KNOWN AS
BARANGAY LIWON IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF
ASIPULO, PROVINCE OF IFUGAO

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. Creation of Barangay Liwon. — The
Special Economic Zone of Liwon in Barangay Amduntog,
Municipality of Asipulo, Province of Ifugao is hereby
constituted as a distinct and independent barangay to be
known as Barangay Liwon.

SEC. 2. Territorial Boundaries. — The territorial
boundaries of Barangay Liwon shall be identified as follows:

Bounded on the South (S), along line 1 to 2, by Barangay
Namal;
 
On the West (W), along line 2 to 3, by Municipality of
Tinoc, Province of Ifugao;

On the North (N), along line 3 to 4, by Municipality
of Kiangan;

On the Northeast (NE), along lines 4 to 6, by Barangay
Nunggawa;

On the East (E), along lines 6 to 11, by Barangay
Amduntog;

On the Southwest (SW), along lines 11 to 1, by Barangay
Antipolo.

The technical description of Barangay Liwon
is as follows:

Containing an area of 20,938,874 square meters, which
includes 1,090,407 square meters boundary dispute
between Barangay Liwon and Municipality of Kiangan.

SEC. 3. Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. —
Pursuant to Section 10 of Republic Act No. 7160, as
amended, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code
of 1991", the new barangay shall exist upon obtaining
a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be conducted
and supervised by the Commission on Elections
(COMELEC) in Barangay Amduntog, Municipality of
Asipulo, Province of Ifugao not later than one hundred
twenty (120) days from the effectivity of this Act.

The expenses for the plebiscite shall be borne by the
Municipality of Asipulo, Province of Ifugao.

SEC. 4. Barangay Officials. ~ The first set of barangay
officials of Barangay Liwon shall be appointed by the
Provincial Governor of the Province of Ifugao and shall
hold office until such time that the new set of officers
have been duly elected and qualified.

SEC. 5. Public Infrastructure and Facilities. — All
public infrastructure and facilities for public use existing
therein at the time of the approval of this Act are hereby
transferred without cost or compensation to and shall
be administered by the new barangay.

SEC. 6. Internal Revenue Allotment Shares. — Barangay
Liwon shall be entitled to Internal Revenue Allotment
(IRA) shares pursuant to Section 285 of Republic Act
No. 7160, as amended, otherwise known as the "Local
Government Code of 1991".
 
Sxc. 7. Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or
in a newspaper of general circulation.
